Storm survey team found evidence of an EF0 tornado with estimated peak winds of 85 mph. The tornado touched down near the Mill Creek neighborhood, then crossed NC 210 before causing notable damage to a home. The tornado then caused minor damage around a commercial property before lifting. The tornado was estimated to be on the ground for 0.2 miles, with an estimated width of 50 yards.

Storm survey team found evidence of an EF1 tornado with estimated peak winds of 110 mph and an estimated width of 50 yards. The tornado likely first touched down in the marshland area north of Old Folkstone Road, then traveled southeast causing notable damage to multiple homes, an apartment complex, and an RV park. The tornado then moved through a forested area south of Old Folkstone Road before lifting near NC 210.
